svg.title: Scheduler::Plan: from jobs to an action DAG
svg.desc: PlanRequest flows through job expansion, tray assignment and AGV assignment, which build the event DAG (task level); CHUGG plans timed motions from it (MAPF); the response builds a new graph, the action DAG (an action dependency graph), which Dispatch executes.

g.text: Scheduler::Plan: from jobs to an action DAG

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Stages 1-3 build one event DAG; CHUGG turns it into timed trajectories; the response builds a second DAG, of actions, from those trajectories. Simplified: checks and failure paths are omitted.
